attributes.title: 2027 WIN Conference: 60th Annual Communicating Nursing Research Conference
attributes.summary:
The Western Institute of Nursing holds its 60th Annual Communicating Nursing Research Conference from Tuesday, April 6, to Friday, April 9, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Bellevue on Seattle's Eastside. The anniversary theme is "Celebrating 60 Years of Excellence in Nursing Research, Practice, and Education." Nurse researchers, educators, clinicians and students from the western states present studies and posters.

Registration opens in December 2026. WIN lists anticipated fees of $550 for individual members, $735 for non-members and $380 for member students, new graduates and retirees, with $50 off for registrations received by February 15, 2027; late and onsite rates from March 29 are about $100 higher. The hotel block at $219 per night closes March 15, 2027. The number of contact hours was not stated on the conference page.
